units.source_text: 后来，我还是后悔，拍遗容这种行为未免太轻率了。

en.t: Later, I still regretted it; taking a photograph of the deceased had been far too rash.

units.source_text: 遗容照恐怕也不应该保存。

en.t: A photograph of the deceased probably should not have been kept either.

units.source_text: 但从这张照片看，名人那不平凡的生涯引起了我的共鸣，这也是事实。

en.t: But it is also true that, looking at this photograph, the Master's extraordinary life stirred a deep response in me.
